verdict.rationale: Docs confirm SES supports a 'Templated' message type with personalization tags (merge fields) for automatic value substitution, but there is no evidence of a documented templating language with conditionals or loops, nor any preview/test-render feature. Community feedback even notes users must build templating functionality themselves ('you need to code a lot of the stuff Mailchimp has out of the box like templates... yourself'), indicating SES's templating is basic compared to the story's ask. missing for 10: documented conditional/loop syntax, template preview/test-render tooling, independent corroboration of advanced templating use.
